FX-FOAM-001.says: As added: the Draft view, the red producer in the middle and thirty tiny blue rings a second drifting right; frame 0 the producer alone.

FX-FOAM-002.says: A close look, Rendered: bigger bubbles from a bigger producer, fifteen a second; frame 0 clear, frame 1 the first born, too small to see.

FX-FOAM-003.says: The close look in the Draft view: rings.

FX-FOAM-004.says: The producer at 25, 75, wide and flat, turned 30 degrees.

FX-FOAM-005.says: Zoom 2, the producer kept where it was put on screen: bubbles twice as big, drifting twice as fast.

FX-FOAM-006.says: Zoom 2 with Zoom Producer Point on: the producer grown too.

FX-FOAM-008.says: Size Variance 0: every bubble the same size.

FX-FOAM-009.says: Size 6: big bubbles crowding and pushing.

FX-FOAM-010.says: Lifespan 15 (half a second): the old ones popped.

FX-FOAM-011.says: Bubble Growth Speed 1: full size in a tenth of a second.

FX-FOAM-012.says: Strength 1 with Lifespan 30: most pop well before the second is out.

FX-FOAM-013.says: Initial Speed 2 towards 180 degrees: thrown down.

FX-FOAM-014.says: Wind 4 towards 0 degrees: blown up and away.

FX-FOAM-019.says: Pop Velocity 20 with short lives: each pop shoves its neighbours.

FX-FOAM-020.says: Viscosity 1: the wind barely moves them.

FX-FOAM-021.says: Stickiness 0: neighbours do not drag each other.

FX-FOAM-022.says: Universe Size 0.5 with a strong wind: gone before the layer's edge.

FX-FOAM-023.says: Blend Mode Solid Old on Top.

FX-FOAM-024.says: Blend Mode Solid New on Top.

FX-FOAM-028.says: Bubble Texture Layer: the picture in every bubble.

FX-FOAM-029.says: Layer texture, Bubble Orientation Physical: each picture turned its own way.

FX-FOAM-030.says: Layer texture, Bubble Orientation Velocity: each picture's top the way it moves.

FX-FOAM-031.says: Reflection Strength 0.7, Convergence 0: each bubble shows the picture round it.

FX-FOAM-032.says: Reflection Strength 0.7, Convergence 1: each bubble shows the whole picture.

FX-FOAM-033.says: Simulation Quality High: two steps a frame.

FX-FOAM-034.says: Simulation Quality Intense: four steps a frame.

FX-FOAM-036.says: Production Rate keyed from 0 at frame 0 to 2 at frame 24: born slowly, then faster.

FX-FOAM-037.says: Wind Direction keyed from 0 to 180 over frames 0 to 24: blown up, then round and down.

FX-FOAM-038.says: FX-FOAM-002 moved 3 pixels right: the same, moved.

FX-FOAM-039.says: FX-FOAM-002 with the layer starting at frame 6: frame 6 clear, frame 18 002's frame 12.

FX-FOAM-040.says: FX-FOAM-002 at 30 frames a second: frame 12 is two fifths of a second in.

FX-FOAM-041.says: The half picture with the Layer texture: half of each bubble's picture clear.
